name: Kodoku no Yurikago
source:
“That day”—it’s been a year since July 22nd…
The scars from that day haven’t faded.
Mio, who died.
Kazuha, who disappeared.
Left alone, I’ve been drifting through a hazy, half-conscious world.
—Then, one day.
Mio, the girl I thought had died in front of me, suddenly appeared again—
……
Turns out, she’s just a lookalike. A completely different person.
She said she’s a transfer student.
But come on… that’s not something that just happens, right?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ204066.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
“那一天”——距离7月22日已经过去一年了……
那天留下的伤疤还没有消退。
澪，死了。
失踪的一羽。
独自一人，我在一个朦胧、半意识的世界里漂流。
——然后，有一天。
原本以为已经死在眼前的少女澪突然又出现了——
……
事实证明，她只是一个长得像的人。一个完全不同的人。
她说她是转学生。
但得了吧……这不是偶然发生的事情，对吧？

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ204066.html/]dlsite[/url]]
